←About us
SSM

SSM is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, and has regional headquarters and operations centers in major port cities around the world, including Singapore, Amsterdam, New York, Dubai, and Shanghai.

A major player in the global container shipping sector, SSM is committed to providing multinational commercial enterprises with efficient, safe, and reliable maritime logistics solutions, connecting all major ports and markets worldwide.

Vision for the future and strategic direction: Building the world's smartest, most efficient, and most environmentally friendly container shipping network.

📌 Strategy 1: Leader in smart maritime transport

Develop a cutting-edge maritime data platform to optimize forecasting and planning capabilities.

📌 Strategy 2: Leader in eco-friendly maritime transport

Accelerate the development of low-carbon fuels and energy-efficient transport fleets, while continuously improving energy efficiency.

📌 Strategy 3: Collaboration across global port systems

Deepen partnerships with major ports, logistics companies, and trade partners worldwide to create a more seamless global supply chain.

Mission Statement:

"Making every maritime shipment faster, more stable, and more sustainable." We are not merely providers of maritime transport services, but guardians of global trade routes.
